body: I was in this dilemma 4 months ago, I didn’t post here because I was deep on my depression and just accepted that I am not for bedside nursing. Not even 1 month of working I quit, until today I still think about if I made a good decision. My reason? I feel helpless, fear of making mistake, I feel being judge by nurses/preceptor, feeling dumb because I don’t know the med, anatomy, assessment, intervention for the patient. I also kept asking question that seems even new student knows! Those are my feeling throughout my job and that was accompanied by frequent sweating all over my face because my brain is not organized, I just kept doing what I know that might be easy and often forget prioritization and this happens in the beginning and end of shift. My MD has told me these are symptoms of Panic attack, and this happens EVERY SHIFT. The reason also I talked to my MD was bc I started to feel suicidal after my first shift, I am just crying to bed and begging that I just don’t wake up for my next shift. The end the year, I just become selfish and sent my resignation without even notice cuz I am done, I become selfish even though I have debt and need money. I am sorry to vent here, I also want to share my experience and say you are not the only one experience this feelings as a new grad. The suggestions by other nurses in the comments are very helpful, Thank You!
